dossier_meta.catalog_title: Optimality of the $o(n^{3/2})$ bound in Corollary 1.4
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is the exponent $3/2$ in the conclusion of Corollary 1.4 best possible? (Corollary 1.4 states: every $n$-vertex $C_5$-free graph can be made triangle-free by deleting $o(n^{3/2})$ edges.)
dossier_meta.context_text: Immediately after stating Corollary 1.4, the authors note that they do not know whether the exponent $3/2$ is best possible. Proposition 1.5 shows that the hypothesis in the related Corollary 1.3 cannot be relaxed, but does not directly address the tightness of the exponent in Corollary 1.4. Proposition 1.7 shows the exponent $3/2$ in Theorem 1.6 is tight.
